text:
emma_sales: Dropping the pen-test + vuln-scan bundle for NimbusHealth into the shared artifacts bucket: s3://redwood-enterprise-artifacts/nimbus/2026-03-20/nimbus-pt-vuln-bundle.zip. Please verify checksums and confirm owners so we can send to legal.

ops-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-enterprise-artifacts/nimbus/2026-03-20/nimbus-pt-vuln-bundle.zip (size: 52.1 MB).

security-scanner-bot: Scan summary attached: STATIC-2026-03-20 (14 high, 19 med, 37 low), DYNAMIC-AUTH-2026-03-20 (2 critical, 4 high). Report IDs: PT-2026-0320-01, SCA-2026-0320-02.

emma_sales: Customer wants a risk-tiered remediation timeline they can attach to their SOC team. Also requested SHA256 checksums for the package upfront. Checksum: 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015... (full value in S3 README).

raj_security: Quick confirmation Q: did the tester run authenticated checks against prod-like data? The README lists a service account; want to be explicit in the customer note.

emma_sales: Yes — test account creds included in README.txt inside the zip (rotated after testing). Mapping CSV links vuln IDs to endpoints and whether auth was required.

maria_engineering: I started triage on the two critical items. One maps to runtime tokenizer overflow (tracked in GH issue redwood/runtime#810). I have a branch with validation + unit tests. ETA for PR: 2026-03-23, target canary deploy 2026-03-25.

nick_sre: For infra-level CVEs we own, I'll need to coordinate package upgrades and a maintenance window. Proposed window: 2026-03-26 01:00-03:00 UTC. Please tag infra items in the sheet so I can create change requests.

raj_security: I'll produce a customer-ready spreadsheet with columns: finding_id, summary, severity, cwe, auth_required, exploitability, owner, owner_team, remediation_eta, proof_of_fix_s3_path, public_status. Provisional owners included. Expect first-pass CSV by EOD.

emma_sales: Sounds good. Customer asked for priority wording: "Critical = active exploit or complete data exposure; High = auth bypass or priv escalation; Medium = information exposure; Low = configuration." Use that language in the summary.

security-scanner-bot: Evidence artifacts uploaded: logs/, diffs/, test-results/ under s3://redwood-enterprise-artifacts/nimbus/2026-03-20/evidence/. Hash manifest: manifest.sha256.

maria_engineering: I'll add proof-of-fix artifacts to the evidence path: failing test reproducer, unit test output, patch diff. Will link GH PRs in the sheet.

raj_security: First-pass remediation spreadsheet uploaded: s3://redwood-enterprise-artifacts/nimbus/2026-03-20/nimbus-remediation-firstpass.csv. Assigned owners for all Critical/High items. Please review and confirm or reassign.

emma_sales: I'm about to share with the customer's security lead. Before I do, confirm the two critical items are being treated as top priority with canary by 2026-03-25 and full rollout by 2026-03-28?

maria_engineering: Confirmed for runtime critical: PR by 03-23, canary 03-25, full rollout 03-28 assuming canary metrics look stable.

nick_sre: Infra CVE (item INF-6) scheduled for package upgrade in the 03-26 window. I'll post the change request and rollback plan.

raj_security: Note for customer: we require proof-of-fix artifacts before we mark items resolved for audits. That will be: PR link, CI test logs, and evidence S3 path. I'll add "proof checklist" column to the CSV.

emma_sales: Also adding the checksum verification instructions for the customer: ```aws s3 cp s3://redwood-enterprise-artifacts/nimbus/2026-03-20/nimbus-pt-vuln-bundle.zip ./ && sha256sum nimbus-pt-vuln-bundle.zip``` Expect: 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015...

maria_engineering: I'll join the sync with the customer's security lead on Thu 2026-03-21 15:00 PT to walk code fixes for ~15 minutes.

raj_security: I'll present the risk-tiering and evidence requirements. Emma, please include the remediation spreadsheet link and the S3 manifest in the invite.

emma_sales: Invite sent. I'll include folks from legal if we need to confirm evidence redaction.

nick_sre: Quick ops note: if any fix requires kernel-level updates, we may need a longer maintenance window — will flag in the CR.

raj_security: Uploaded revised CSV with updated ETAs after engineering review: s3://redwood-enterprise-artifacts/nimbus/2026-03-20/nimbus-remediation-v2.csv (changed some highs to 2026-04-07 based on testing complexity).

emma_sales: Thank you. I'll send the customer the v2 spreadsheet and the S3 artifact checksums now. Will follow up after the sync with the security lead. :white_check_mark:

security-scanner-bot: Automated note: manifest SHA256 verified for nimbus-pt-vuln-bundle.zip.

emma_sales: Closing thread — will post updates as items progress to resolved. If anyone changes ETA or owner, please update the CSV in S3 so customers always see current state."
